basic_info.description: Video Preview! On the Top of Pacific Heights, less than 300' from the marquee corner of Lafayette Park & 2.5 blocks to Fillmore is a rare opportunity. 2443 & 2445 Washington are two remodeled condominiums in a 2 unit building, each with exquisite exclusive outdoor living spaces offered separately...simultaneously. Intuitively designed & well built in 1948, the shared entry courtyard leads to the 2 front doors in the center of the floor plates. 2445 Washington is the upper, 2 level, 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home. The entry foyer welcomes you. The living room with fireplace looks north to Washington Street & leads to the dining room connected with the open remodeled kitchen. A powder room is between the living area & the 2 lower bedrooms. The west bedroom is a suite.  The top floor begins with a spacious view roof terrace. The primary suite has custom closets, a luxurious bath & another, full property width, south facing terrace overlooking the incredible shared garden. The condominium has a large storage room, laundry area & 2 car parking.
